v1.0.0.changelog: Initial rollout of custom PTZ camera assembly, local Ollama summary engine, and local face verification pipeline.

spec.overview: An AI-powered smart classroom management system featuring custom-built PTZ cameras, localized face verification pipelines, and automated learning analytics driven by local offline LLMs.
spec.architecture: Features custom Sony IMX sensor hardware modules on Raspberry Pi 4 running edge vision pipeline, streaming coordinates to server, and local Ollama server running Llama-3 for audio transcription analysis.

subsystems.name: Dashboard Interface
subsystems.function: React UI rendering class statistics, summary sheets, and interactive student registry.

subsystems.name: Class API Server
subsystems.function: Node.js service coordinating live camera streams and transcribing class audio.

subsystems.name: Relational Registry
subsystems.function: MySQL database archiving student vectors and transcription models.

subsystems.name: PTZ Edge Hardware
subsystems.function: Servo motor brackets and Sony IMX sensor assembly running on Raspberry Pi 4.

subsystems.name: Edge Classifier
subsystems.function: Rapid attendance verification pipeline utilizing OpenCV, HOG, and CNN bounds check.

subsystems.name: Echo Minds Offline LLM
subsystems.function: Ollama engine running local quantized Llama-3 weights to extract study notes.

spec.challenges: Running Ollama and OpenCV on Raspberry Pi 4 simultaneously caused severe RAM exhaustion.
spec.engineeringDecisions: Constructed client-side threshold check triggering face CNN classifier only when a candidate enters viewport bounds.
spec.lessonsLearned: 4-bit quantized GGUF weights are necessary for reliable edge LLM inference loops.
spec.futureImprovements: Compile OpenCV pipelines to WebAssembly modules to support thin browser streaming clients.

interviewQuestions.q: How did you optimize memory usage on Raspberry Pi 4 when running Ollama and OpenCV simultaneously?
interviewQuestions.a: Lowered camera input frames resolution to 640x480 grayscale, and loaded strict 3B parameter model files restricted to 2GB cache bounds.

replay.title: PTZ Assembly & Shell Setup
replay.description: Configured servo drivers on Raspberry Pi and assembled 3D printed camera bracket.
replay.decisions: Selected Raspberry Pi 4 with custom Sony IMX camera for high sensitivity in low-light classrooms.
replay.challenges: Servo jittering due to software PWM timing errors.
replay.lessons: Utilized hardware-level clock timing libraries (pigpio) to achieve steady 50Hz control cycles.

replay.title: Edge Facial Verification
replay.description: Developed localized feature extraction pipelines with HOG and CNN model models.
replay.decisions: Created dynamic threshold triggers to execute CNN validation on movement only.
replay.challenges: High false positive classification in low light conditions.
replay.lessons: Preprocessing frames with adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE) reduced ambient light bias.

replay.title: Quantized LLM Note Compiler
replay.description: Integrated local Ollama server running quantized Llama-3 model for lecture audio analytics.
replay.decisions: Fitted 3B quantized parameter weights restricted to 2GB memory capacity limits.
replay.challenges: High prompt execution latency (10+ seconds per answer).
replay.lessons: Pre-segmenting raw transcripts and chunking inputs kept responses below 2 seconds.
